notes.title: A Heartfelt Thank You and an Important Update
notes.notes:
First, I want to take a moment to thank each and every one of you for playing Temple of Shadows. Seeing your enthusiasm, creativity, and passion—whether through streams, reviews, or feedback—has been nothing short of incredible. It means the world to me to see so many of you enjoying the experience I’ve worked hard to create.

Unfortunately, I need to share some important news. While working on a bug fix to resolve inaccurate speed-run times, I inadvertently caused an issue that may have corrupted some save files. If your file was affected, you will notice in the options menu that no completed level times are displayed. For this, I sincerely apologize. This mistake does not reflect the standard I hold myself to, and I hope it won’t tarnish your feelings toward the game.

The good news is that all achievements and logged speed-run times remain unaffected.

I truly appreciate your understanding and continued support. I am committed to ensuring Temple of Shadows becomes an unforgettable experience for everyone. If you encounter any issues or have further feedback, please don’t hesitate to reach out at our discord or email. 

Discord: discord.drbstudios.gg
Email: staff@drbstudios.gg

Thank you for being part of this journey,
Chris
DRB Studios

notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.0.4
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers! We've been working hard to polish your experience in Temple of Shadows. Here’s what’s included in this latest update:

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue causing inaccurate speedrun times. Ready, set, go!
[*] Fixed a bug where the light beam behaved erratically during camera changes. Light should now remain stable while holding a block.
[*] Corrected a bug in the options menu that caused game time to continue counting while paused.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted level elements to address collision issues and various bugs.
[*] Improved functionality of crosshair elements for certain interactive objects.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! If you run into any issues, let us know in the community forums or our new [url=discord.drbstudios.gg]Discord Server[/url].

Happy exploring!
— The Temple of Shadows Team

notes.title: Patch Update: Issues Resolved!
notes.notes:
🛠️ A recent patch has resolved the following issues:

1️⃣ French language is now back in the settings menu.
2️⃣ Fixed a bug preventing the final credits scene from activating for some players.

💾 Please make sure your game is updated to the latest version to enjoy these fixes!

Thank you for your feedback and support—your reports help us improve the game for everyone. If you encounter any other issues, let us know on Discord: discord.drbstudios.gg.

Happy adventuring! 🌌

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
We have pushed a small patch to add a language settings option. 

- added a Language setting to allow players to manually set language if the automatic systems does not work correctly.

Please report any issues you have to staff@drbstudios.gg

Thank You for Playing

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1.0.13
notes.notes:
We have pushed a couple small patches over night to fix a handful of issues and bugs. 

- fixed issue with "Jump" tutorial tip having no button img for keyboard users
- fixed a bug that can cause players to get stuck in final level and unable to progress
- fixed a bug that causes players to not receive final achievement for finishing last level

Please report any issues you have to staff@drbstudios.gg

Thank You for Playing

notes.title: Demo Update v1.02
notes.notes:
We have pushed an update to the Demo to fix a small bug. 

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing floor buttons to launch rocks.
[*] Fixed a bug causing floor buttons to deactivate even when a rock is still on them.
[*] Fixed a bug with the animations of the sarcophagus in the graveyard.

[*] Added more time for exploring in the forest area.
[/list]

Thank you for checking out the Demo and providing feedback via our live streams.

notes.title: Demo Update v1.01
notes.notes:
We have pushed an update to the Demo to fix a small bug and address other concerns. 

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing a platform in the Draw Bridge area to launch a rock out of the map.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the rotating walls to snap to the end of the animation.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing players to set sensitivity to zero, causing movement to be frozen.

[*] Added the use of ESC to exit from menus.
[/list]

Thank you for checking out the Demo.
